messages:
marina: Heads up — PR for audit schema v4 just merged to staging. Main additions: kms.key_id, rbac.action_details, and processing_node metadata. Need a short customer validation plan, sample payloads (masked), and a concise changelog for docs. Who can own the customer-facing advisory?

dean: I can take the advisory and changelog draft. Can you paste the sample payloads we want customers to validate so I can embed them?

marina: Minimal customer-facing sample (mask secrets in docs):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01HXXXX",
  "schema_version": "v4",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T15:12:34Z",
  "user": { "id": "usr_1234", "email": "redacted@example.com" },
  "rbac": { "action": "resource.write", "action_details": { "reason": "deploy", "scope": "team:infra" } },
  "resource": { "type": "model_endpoint", "id": "ep-09" },
  "kms": { "key_id": "kms:key-****" },
  "outcome": "success",
  "processing_node": "zone-a-rt-3"
}
```

tara: For customer validation I recommend two simple artifacts: 1) a pair of sample events (happy + failure) they can ingest, 2) a one-page schema diff that lists added/changed fields and recommended mappings for SIEMs. Also provide Splunk and Datadog example field mappings.

leo: Rollout suggestion: opt-in beta with 8–12 customers who have active SIEM integrations. Add an audit-sampling feature flag we can enable per-customer. If we see schema validation failures, automatically fallback to schema v3 for that tenant and send an alert to sec-oncall. We should also emit telemetry counts for "validation_failures" and "unknown_fields".

marina: Agreed on metrics. Also we need a short FAQ for customers covering: migration window, masking/redaction policy, fallback behavior, and how to request extended support. Dean — please include the masking note in the advisory.

dean: Quick question on masking: legal wants explicit language that KMS identifiers will be partially redacted in any shared logs. Will that break customer SIEM parsers?

tara: We'll include masked and unmasked examples. For public docs and support-repro bundles: mask kms.key_id and user.email. For customer-owned SIEM integration instructions, show the full mapping but call out which fields are sensitive. Example masked form: `kms:key-****`.

nora-bot: staging-deploy-bot: pipeline status: staging rollout passed schema checks (3/3). Ingestion smoke-tests: OK. No validation failures recorded in last 60m.

leo: Timeline proposal: 2 weeks for beta outreach + docs, 1 week for customer validation and signoffs, then staged ramp. Does that work?

marina: That works. Action items: Dean — draft advisory & changelog; Tara — SIEM mappings and sample queries; Leo — compile beta candidate list and coordinate enable flags; I will prepare customer ticket templates and the changelog PR. :thumbsup:

dean: Assigned. I'll also ping legal about redaction wording and add a short migration checklist.

tara: I'll add Splunk queries and a Datadog log pipeline example (will include a basic detection rule for unexpected rbac.action values).

leo: Quick smoke-test snippet to include in docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://events.redwood.ai/ingest \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Audit-Schema: v4' \n  -d @sample_event_v4.json
```

marina: Thanks all — I'll open the customer advisory draft and changelog PR this afternoon and link them here. Please drop beta customer suggestions in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

marina: (follow-up) Also adding a one-click support template so SREs can request schema-rollback per-tenant if needed.

leo: :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: audit logging coverage and customer validation; single-thread slack-style document
